newsitem.title: USA: Hyperion signs deal with MCI.
newsitem.headline: Hyperion signs deal with MCI.

text.p: Hyperion Telecommunications Inc said Wednesday it signed a preferred provider deal with MCI Communications Corp.
Hyperion, which is an 88 percent owned subsidiary of Adelphia Communications Corp, said the agreement named it as MCI's preferred provider of end-user access circuits.
Hyperion said the company issued MCI warrants to buy up to 2.5 percent of its common stock as part of the deal.
MCI could receive warrants to buy up to an additional six percent of Hyperion's stock if it meets certain agreed-upon purchase levels, the company said.
A spokesman was unavailable to elaborate.
